Self-hosted font files (latin subsets, downloaded from Google Fonts).

ibm-plex-mono-400-latin.woff2  IBM Plex Mono 400                 SIL Open Font License 1.1
ibm-plex-mono-500-latin.woff2  IBM Plex Mono 500                 SIL Open Font License 1.1
material-icons.woff2           Material Icons (Filled)           Apache License 2.0
google-sans-flex-ascii.woff2   Google Sans Flex (wght 300-800,   SIL Open Font License 1.1
                               ROND 0-100; ASCII subset)
